deals.comment: On Media Corp. (KOSE:A045710) acquired an additional stake in Orion Cinema Network Co., Ltd. for KRW 20 billion in cash on October 12, 2006.

CJ O Shopping Co., Ltd. (KOSE: A035760) agreed to acquire a 55.17% stake in On Media Corp. from Orion Corporation (KOSE: A001800), Tam Cheol-gon and other shareholders for approximately KRW 430 billion in cash on December 24, 2009. CJ O Shopping will offer KRW 6669 per share of On Media. The offer price represents a 71% premium to the On Media’s closing price of December 23, 2009. If South Korea's Fair Trade Commission doesn't approve of the majority stake purchase, then CJ O Shopping is expected to acquire about 15% stake of On Media. The deal is subject to regulatory approval and approval of South Korea's Fair Trade Commission. The transaction was approved by the Board of Directors. The deal is expected to close by the first half of 2010. 

As of May 31, 2010, the deal was approved by the South Korea's Fair Trade Commission. As of June 8, 2010, Orion Corporation sold it share in On Media Corp. HSBC Bank plc acted as financial advisor to Orion Corporation. Morgan Stanley acted as financial advisor and Kpmg Samjong Accounting Corporation acted as a financial due diligence to CJ O Shopping.

O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. (KOSE: A130960) signed a statuary merger agreement to acquire remaining 44.83% stake in On Media Corp. (KOSE: A045710) from Capital International, Inc., CIPEF III, CIPEF II and others for approximately KRW 190 billion in stock on November 16, 2010. The exchange ratio for the transaction is 1: 0.1212693. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. also signed agreement to acquire CJ Internet Corp., M-net Media Corp, CJ Media Inc. and CJ Entertainment Inc. The deal is subject to approval of shareholders of O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. The deal is expected to close on March 1, 2011.

As of February 2, 2011, O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. (KOSE: A130960) agreed to acquire remaining 51.37% stake in On Media Corp. (KOSE: A045710).

On Media Corp. (KOSE: A045710) acquired an additional 7% stake in On Game Network Inc. from CJ Internet Corp. (KOSE: A037150) for approximately KRW 970 million on December 30, 2010. On Media Corp acquired 0.24 million shares at the price of KRW 4060 per share. On Game Network reported revenues of KRW 22.5 billion, net loss of KRW 899 million, total assets of KRW 21.3 billion and total stockholders equity of KRW 19 billion in 2010.

CJ E&M Corporation (KOSE:A130960) agreed to acquire remaining 33.79% stake in Baduk Television Co Ltd for $11 million in stock on August 21, 2013. CJ E&M will issue one share of its common stock for 0.2699598 shares of Baduk Television. Pursuant to the transaction, Baduk Television will be dissolved. In related transactions, CJ E&M will also acquire remaining stakes in Orion Cinema Network Co Ltd, On Game Network Inc, Korea Music Television Co., Ltd and International Media Genius in stock. As combined consideration, 0.8 million shares will be issued out of which 0.38 million shares will be issued from treasury. The consideration shares will be issued on December 16, 2013. On August 23, 2013 an agreement was entered. Upon completion of issuance of consideration shares, outstanding shares of CJ E&M will increase from 37.56 million to 38.35 million. Baduk Television reported revenues of $17.97 million, total assets of $25.22 million, net income of $3.12 million and total common equity of $21.11 million for the year ending December 31, 2012. The transaction is expected to close on December 1, 2013. PricewaterhouseCoopers Korea acted as accountant for CJ E&M. The currency conversion for the financials was done by www.oanda.com dated December 31, 2012.

CJ E&M Corporation (KOSE:A130960) agreed to acquire remaining minority stake in Orion Cinema Network Co., Ltd. for KRW 29.8 billion in stock on August 21, 2013. CJ E&M will issue 0.651406 shares for every share of Orion. Pursuant to the transaction, Orion Cinema will be dissolved. The transaction is expected to close on December 1, 2013. As of September 4, 2013, the merger ratio was amended. CJ E&M will issue 0.648594 share for every share of Orion. CJ E&M will issue 0.8 million shares of its common stock. PricewaterhouseCoopers Korea acted as accountant for CJ E&M.
